## Product description
Introduce a touch of enchanting elegance with the MITHRAS CANADA Double Layered Diamond finsh Snowflakes Pendant Necklace and Earring Set. This stunning jewellery set features a delicate double-strand gold-toned wire necklace adorned with sparkling crystal snowflake pendants and lustrous faux pearl accents, creating a beautifully layered look that catches the light from every angle. The matching drop earrings feature the same intricate snowflake design with hook-style clasps, perfectly complementing the necklace for a cohesive, polished appearance. The adjustable hook clasp ensures a comfortable and secure fit. Versatile enough for both young girls and women, this set pairs beautifully with festive ethnic wear, party dresses, or special occasion outfits. Whether it's a wedding, festival, or celebration, this charming set is sure to make you the centre of attention. A wonderful gift choice for loved ones of all ages.
